summary: TrustCo Bank Corp NY filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026, reporting that on September 15 the Board unanimously expanded its size from nine to eleven directors and elected Patricia Kieper-Fusco and Bryan L. Guentner to fill the resulting vacancies, effective immediately, with the bank subsidiary's board taking corresponding action. Both qualify as independent under Nasdaq and SEC audit/compensation committee standards and join all standing committees. They will receive standard non-employee director compensation with no initial equity awards; no related-party arrangements exist. This routine board-expansion disclosure, not a forced departure, presents no deal or arbitrage angle.
